role: mutated copies are rejection tests only

rejected.missing_m273: missing, extra or out-of-order Material step
rejected.incorrect_total: the passing suite totals do not match the runner summary
rejected.wrong_independent_adapter: the browser or adapter differs from the expected runtime metadata
rejected.wrong_theme_capture: decoded bar, pill or rounded corner pixels disagree with the report
rejected.unscrolled_capture: wheel screenshots did not show changing content
rejected.wrong_activation_count: wrong keyboard or pointer activation, or a title escaped the fixed header
rejected.wrong_linux_adapter: the observed Linux WebGPU adapter did not match the SwiftShader pin
